author: Darius, G. et al.
title: Measurement of the Electron-Antineutrino Angular Correlation in Neutron Beta Decay
abstract: We report the first result for the electron-antineutrino angular correlation (a coefficient) in free neutron beta decay from the aCORN experiment. aCORN uses a novel method in which the a coefficient is proportional to an asymmetry in proton time of flight for events where the beta electron and recoil proton are detected in delayed coincidence.
